video_title: Ray Allen: The 3 Levels of Shooting (Most Players Never Reach Level 3)

quotes.speaker: Ray Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Ray Allen on his initial lack of preparation for the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I had no clue. You get drafted, I get drafted 1996, I'm walking into a game.
quotes.quote: My first year in the NBA I wasn't, I had no clue. You get drafted, I get drafted 1996, I'm walking into a game with some of the history's greatest two guards collectively when you go down the board. I watched these people grow up my whole life and it was different then because everybody has a skill set, different from the others, that when you see them, I don't know how to guard these dudes. Great shooters, great post-up guys and I'm like, how am I going to have an impact? How am I going to be great on this game?

quotes.speaker: Ray Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Ray Allen on the importance of showing up and being consistent
quotes.excerpt: Show up every day. Be the guy that when they look up, he's here.
quotes.quote: Show up every day. Be the guy that when they look up, he's here. He does this every single day. I don't know what my talent is going to provide, but my presence showing up every single day, being on time, I can do that. And then when you show up every single day, imagine showing up somewhere every single day doing something. I started realizing greatness isn't hitting the big shot or dunking on somebody. We've seen plenty of guys do that. We've seen guys flash in the pan score 50. Greatness is showing up every single day doing the same thing over and over again.

quotes.speaker: Ray Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Ray Allen on the definition of greatness through consistency
quotes.excerpt: Greatness is showing up every single day doing the same thing over and over again.
quotes.quote: What drove me, and it still drives me today, was to be the best in everything I do. So when I got up, I knew what my marching orders were. If you want to be popular, then you're going to fail in your endeavor. If you want to make a lot of money, because money is the most common thing in the world, everybody has it. May not have a lot of it, but everybody has it. Everybody spends money at some point through one way or another. So find something that drives you every day and do that every single day.

quotes.speaker: Ray Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Ray Allen on establishing a professional routine
quotes.excerpt: I started realizing I have to establish a routine. And so from my second year on, I was always early.
quotes.quote: My first year, I was doing bogus stuff, not working out consistently, didn't have a routine. Then that second year I started realizing I have to establish a routine. And so from my second year on, I was always early. I was always where my feet were planted because before, I used to have one foot in and one foot out because I was like, nobody was forcing me to work out extra, there was no real strong culture. You had so much time on your hands, you had to now figure it out.

quotes.speaker: Ray Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Ray Allen on Gerald Oliver's influence on his jump shot
quotes.excerpt: He was probably one of the most instrumental guys that I had in talking to me about jump shot.
quotes.quote: Gerald Oliver, he was probably one of the most instrumental guys that I had in talking to me about jump shot. And Gerald was a boxer, but he was, you know, there was nothing remarkable about his appearance. He was just an older white guy, bald, he was from Georgia and he was like real southern. And he come up and he's like, buddy, let me tell you something. And he would put index in my cards in my locker and he'd say, let me tell you something. And I always tell kids this and I try to tell them, but it's a commitment that people aren't willing to make.

quotes.speaker: Ray Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Ray Allen on the three levels of shooting
quotes.excerpt: He said you got three levels to shooting. He said your C level can make the all-star team.
quotes.quote: He said you got three levels to shooting. He said your C level can, you know, you can make the all-star team and most people shoot a C level. Your B level, you can be a great player in this league and A, you can be legendary and one of the best ever. And he said it's about your commitment to your lift every single time and getting that same lift and being consistent in that every single time.

quotes.speaker: Ray Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Ray Allen on the importance of body mechanics in shooting
quotes.excerpt: I didn't watch a single shot go in. All I did was watch your body.
quotes.quote: He's like, I didn't watch a single shot go in. All I did was watch your body. And every single time it looked the same over and over again. And that was what I, I struggled with it. It was, it was, it was like a burning cross on, on who I was because I, I knew it was beneficial and I needed it, but it, like every day I walked in the gym, I knew what I had to do.

quotes.speaker: Ray Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Ray Allen on the difficulty of committing to the shooting process
quotes.excerpt: It's not duplicatable because kids don't want to put the work in. It's a huge commitment.
quotes.quote: It's not duplicatable because kids don't want to put the work in. It's a huge commitment every single day to get your release point the same. And I, I, I, people always ask me what's the secret and I was like, there's no secret, but it's commitment. It's the commitment to the process and to the work. And you, you have to, you have to not be afraid of tired. When you get tired, you're in the right place because now you learn to work through this fatigue.

quotes.speaker: Ray Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Ray Allen on pushing yourself to avoid becoming a coward
quotes.excerpt: When people get fatigued, they become cowards because then they take shortcuts.
quotes.quote: Be a maniac and push yourself to a level that nobody can push you and see how you respond. Can you think through it? Can you throw a football? Can you breathe? Can you make a decision? You know, can see, see when people get fatigued, they become cowards because then they take shortcuts. Oh, I'm just going to do it like this because it's easier because I'm, I'm tired, I don't want to do this. And that's what you have to protect against, especially as an athlete.
